desc: Determine a polynomial algorithm for fixed \(D\) using the threshold-label min-cut reduction.
Prove the potential-label and nested-threshold equivalences, including the one-time cost for each selected edge.
Establish binary-search bounds, monotonicity, and conversion from at-most-\(K\) to exactly-\(K\) selections.
Design implementation details and complexity analysis, including directed multiedges and edge cases.
Validate the final algorithm on all three samples.
